note: Expected probe facts for the synthetic fixtures produced by generate.sh. Durations in ms, dimensions in px. 'decodeWithXerror' is the exit expectation of `ffmpeg -xerror -i <file> -f null -`: 0 = clean full decode, 'nonzero' = the decoder must report an error (truncated/invalid data). Limits referenced here are PENDING_D3 test placeholders (300000 ms, 1920x1080), not approved values. 'structural' is the verdict of the independent box-size check (harness/mp4-boxes.mjs). 'pinnedDecode' is asserted only against the pinned build (HARNESS_PINNED=1). In pinned mode every fixture listed here is REQUIRED (no optional skips).

s3-vfr.mp4.note: GENUINE variable frame rate: presentation times (N+floor(N/2)+floor(N/5))/30 s give consecutive intervals of 33, 67 and 100 ms (rounded). Asserted from per-frame best_effort_timestamp_time read by the pinned ffprobe (JSON output). Replaces the CFR file mislabelled VFR at c45319d (Codex PR83 review, blocker 1). S2b VFR policy is NOT decided by this fixture.

s4-hevc.mp4.note: Generated only when the generator has libx265 (it does for the frozen set). In pinned mode the fixture is REQUIRED and the harness runs `ffmpeg -xerror -i <file> -f null -` and asserts a non-zero exit caused by the missing HEVC decoder (not a timeout, signal or spawn error). Codex PR83 review, blocker 4.

pinnedDecode.stderrPattern: no decoder found for: hevc|Decoder \(codec hevc\) not found

s5-truncated.mp4.note: faststart moov is intact so ffprobe succeeds; the truncation is only detected by decoding with -xerror

s6-duration-over-limit-300500ms.mp4.note: +1 frame at 2 fps = +500 ms; finer granularity is not meaningful for a container-level duration limit

s6-metadata-tags.mp4.note: the normalizing remux must remove every one of these

s6-res-over-limit-1922x1080.mp4.note: H.264 needs even dimensions, so the smallest over-limit width is 1922

s9-wrong-container.webm.note: Required in pinned mode. The pinned build has only the mov demuxer, so it cannot open WebM (probe fails, decode with -xerror exits non-zero); a full generator build can.

pinnedDecode.stderrPattern: Invalid data found when processing input

s11a-oversized-moov-size.mp4.note: Oversized/malformed box-size header (authorization checklist item 7; Codex PR83 review, blocker 3). Derived from s10 by fixtures/oversize.mjs. Asserted: (1) the pinned probe and -xerror decode terminate inside the harness limits with no timeout, signal or spawn error, and their exits are recorded; (2) the independent structural check (harness/mp4-boxes.mjs) rejects the file; (3) the harness verdict (structure ok AND probe ok AND decode ok) is never success. Measured with the development FFmpeg 6.1.1: probe exit 0 and decode exit 0 — the decoder TOLERATES a moov that declares ~2 GiB, so only the structural check rejects it. S2b must not rely on decoder exit codes for this class.
